Constructorizer-plus-Facturer co-location is 1,150, and two Facturers together are 1,300; both exceed one level-0 core and would disable Fire Wave protection.

Use three occupied level-0 cores: Core A hosts only the Constructorizer at 500 heat, leaving 500 capacity; Core B hosts one Facturer at 650 heat, leaving 350; Core C hosts the other Facturer at 650 heat, leaving 350. No pair of heavy machines may share a core. Each core’s extractors, processors, power generation, storage and other powered support must fit inside its remaining allowance, with measured total load kept below 1,000 before operation.

answer.answer: Advanced checkpoint.json from evaluation to an implementation-authorized child checkpoint at revision rev_000002_7323ec9a8a69. JSON structure, lineage, acceptance criteria, and source paths were validated.

claims.value: Straylight is a user-owned, portable, agent-first context and durable-work layer that preserves both learned knowledge and live resumable work state—including evidence, decisions, computations, checkpoints, provenance, and next actions—so later agents can inspect, revise, advance, and hand off work.

The retrieval-only baseline was one-shot BM25 top-k at 17/20 cases, 48/53 evidence items, and about 1,070 mean estimated tokens; policy 0.2 workspace recorded 17/20, 46/53, about 2,932 mean estimated tokens, and 11,999-character P95 context. These estimates did not separate cumulative cached replay from uncached input, so they cannot be interpreted as showing that all replayed workspace context was fresh input. Future results must report both quantities separately, while BM25 remains a regression fixture rather than the target architecture.

The first persistent build slice is a snapshot-pinned workspace that reopens a revision-N parent checkpoint, refreshes to N+1 with a compact evidence/constraint diff, provides typed batched query/read using exact and lexical retrieval plus a pluggable semantic path, and atomically commits an immutable child with parent and source lineage without reconstructing the complete prior corpus.

The transition gate requires each case to complete in no more than four workspace calls, match direct-filesystem answer claims, report cumulative cached replay and uncached input separately, exercise the typed hybrid retrieval path, expose the N-to-N+1 diff, commit an immutable lineage-preserving child checkpoint, and demonstrate that refresh avoids complete prior-corpus reconstruction.

claims.value: Straylight is an agent-first, user-owned portable context and durable-work layer that preserves evidence, learned knowledge, and live resumable work state across agent ecosystems.

Cumulative cached replay measures previously cached prompt material replayed across calls; uncached input measures newly supplied input. They must be reported separately, not combined or interpreted as fresh context. The process-per-operation BM25 shell is the lexical regression baseline, not the target architecture.

The first persistent build slice is a snapshot-pinned workspace that reopens a revision-N parent checkpoint, refreshes to N+1 with an explicit diff, provides typed batched query/read operations, combines exact and BM25 retrieval behind a pluggable semantic interface, and atomically commits an immutable child with parent identity and source lineage.

The transition passes when it completes in at most four workspace calls, reproduces the direct-filesystem answer claims, avoids full-corpus reconstruction when checkpoint plus delta suffice, persists an immutable lineage-preserving child that survives reopen, and reports cached replay separately from uncached input.
